name: 20/200 SMA Crossover Pullback
source:
//@version=6
// =====================================================================
//  20 SMA / 200 SMA Crossover + Pullback + Confirmation
//  Pine port of SmaCrossPullbackEA.mq5
//
//  Mandatory sequence, enforced as a state machine:
//     crossover -> pullback to the 20 SMA -> confirmation candle
//     -> stop entry beyond that candle -> 1:2 risk/reward
//
//  A crossover on its own NEVER produces an entry.
//
//  NOTE ON STOP LOSS: the source specification does not define an SL rule
//  and explicitly says not to invent one. "SL anchor" therefore exposes
//  the candidates instead of hardcoding a choice.
// =====================================================================
strategy("20/200 SMA Crossover Pullback", "SMAX 20/200", overlay = true,
     initial_capital         = 10000,
     default_qty_type        = strategy.percent_of_equity,
     default_qty_value       = 10,
     pyramiding              = 0,
     calc_on_every_tick      = false,
     process_orders_on_close = false)

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  INPUTS
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
gI = "Indicators"
fastLen = input.int(20,  "Fast SMA", minval = 1, group = gI)
slowLen = input.int(200, "Slow SMA", minval = 2, group = gI)

gQ = "Sequence rules"
maxBarsAfterCross = input.int(60, "Setup expires after N bars", minval = 0, group = gQ,
     tooltip = "How long a crossover stays valid while waiting for the pullback and confirmation. 0 = never expires. The source spec does not define this.")
requireTouch   = input.bool(true, "Pullback must reach the 20 SMA", group = gQ)
pullTol        = input.float(0.0, "Pullback tolerance (price)", minval = 0, group = gQ,
     tooltip = "Used only when 'must reach' is off: how close to the 20 SMA still counts as a pullback.")
confNeedsClose = input.bool(true, "Confirmation must close beyond the 20 SMA", group = gQ)
requireExtension = input.bool(true, "Price must move AWAY from the 20 SMA before a pullback counts", group = gQ,
     tooltip = "Without this, the bar right after a crossover trivially satisfies 'low <= 20 SMA' and the sequence collapses into a crossover entry - which the specification explicitly forbids.")
extendATR = input.float(0.5, "Extension required (x ATR14)", minval = 0, step = 0.1, group = gQ)
invalidateOpp  = input.bool(true, "Opposite cross cancels the setup", group = gQ)

gA = "ADX filter"
useADX       = input.bool(true, "Only take signals when ADX is above the threshold", group = gA)
adxThreshold = input.float(20.0, "ADX threshold", minval = 0, step = 0.5, group = gA)
adxLen       = input.int(14, "DI length", minval = 1, group = gA)
adxSmooth    = input.int(14, "ADX smoothing", minval = 1, group = gA)

gW2 = "Weekend protection"
blockFridayLate   = input.bool(false, "Block new entries late on Friday", group = gW2,
     tooltip = "Trade #19 in the Aug-Sep 2026 sample entered Fri 18:30, was held over the weekend and lost 7.86 USD - 23.6% of ALL losses in the run.")
fridayCutoffHour  = input.int(15, "Friday cutoff hour (chart time)", minval = 0, maxval = 23, group = gW2)
closeBeforeWeekend = input.bool(false, "Flatten open position at the Friday cutoff", group = gW2)

gE = "Entry"
entryBuf    = input.float(0.0, "Entry buffer beyond the confirmation candle", minval = 0, group = gE)
pendingBars = input.int(6, "Cancel an unfilled stop order after N bars", minval = 0, group = gE)

gS = "Stop loss  (NOT defined by the source spec)"
slMode  = input.string("Confirmation candle", "SL anchor",
     options = ["Confirmation candle", "Pullback swing", "200 SMA", "Fixed distance"], group = gS)
slBuf   = input.float(0.0, "SL buffer beyond the anchor", minval = 0, group = gS)
fixedSL = input.float(3.0, "Fixed SL distance (price)", minval = 0, group = gS)

gT = "Target"
rr = input.float(2.0, "Risk : Reward", minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = gT)

gP = "Position sizing"
useRiskSizing = input.bool(false, "Size from risk %", group = gP,
     tooltip = "On: quantity is derived so each trade risks the chosen % of equity. Off: uses the Properties tab order size.")
riskPct = input.float(0.5, "Risk % per trade", minval = 0.01, step = 0.1, group = gP)

gW = "Backtest window"
lookbackDays = input.int(0, "Window (days), 0 = all loaded history", minval = 0, group = gW,
     tooltip = "Free/Basic plans have no Deep Backtesting. This limits the test window inside the script instead.")

gV = "Display"
showPanel   = input.bool(true, "Show status panel", group = gV)
showMarkers = input.bool(true, "Show sequence markers", group = gV)
showLevels  = input.bool(true, "Draw entry / SL / target lines", group = gV)

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  INDICATORS
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
fast = ta.sma(close, fastLen)
slow = ta.sma(close, slowLen)

atr14 = ta.atr(14)

isFriday      = dayofweek == dayofweek.friday
fridayBlocked = blockFridayLate and isFriday and hour >= fridayCutoffHour

[diPlus, diMinus, adxVal] = ta.dmi(adxLen, adxSmooth)

bullCross = ta.crossover(fast, slow)
bearCross = ta.crossunder(fast, slow)

inWindow = lookbackDays == 0 or time >= timenow - lookbackDays * 86400000

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  STATE
//    0 = IDLE      no crossover in play
//    1 = CROSSED   crossover seen, waiting for the pullback
//    2 = PULLBACK  pullback done, waiting for confirmation
//    3 = ARMED     confirmation done, stop order working
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
var int   st        = 0
var int   dir       = 0
var int   barsSince = 0
var int   armedBars = 0
var bool  extended  = false
var float pbExt     = na
var float eEntry    = na
var float eSL       = na
var float eTP       = na

var line lnE = na
var line lnS = na
var line lnT = na

pullbackNow = false
confirmNow  = false

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  SEQUENCE
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
if bullCross or bearCross
    // A fresh crossover always restarts the sequence from step one.
    if st == 3
        strategy.cancel("L")
        strategy.cancel("S")
    newDir     = bullCross ? 1 : -1
    st        := 1
    dir       := newDir
    barsSince := 0
    armedBars := 0
    pbExt     := newDir == 1 ? low : high
    extended  := false
    eEntry    := na
    eSL       := na
    eTP       := na

else if st != 0
    barsSince += 1
    isLong = dir == 1

    expired    = maxBarsAfterCross > 0 and barsSince > maxBarsAfterCross
    invalidated = invalidateOpp and ((isLong and fast < slow) or (not isLong and fast > slow))

    if expired or invalidated
        if st == 3
            strategy.cancel("L")
            strategy.cancel("S")
        st     := 0
        dir    := 0
        eEntry := na
        eSL    := na
        eTP    := na

    else if st == 1
        // ---- Step 4/5: pullback toward the 20 SMA
        pbExt := isLong ? math.min(nz(pbExt, low), low) : math.max(nz(pbExt, high), high)

        // Price must first travel away from the 20 SMA, otherwise the bar
        // immediately after the crossover satisfies the test for free.
        movedAway = isLong ? (close - fast >= extendATR * atr14)
                           : (fast - close >= extendATR * atr14)
        if movedAway
            extended := true

        touched = isLong
             ? (requireTouch ? low  <= fast : low  <= fast + pullTol)
             : (requireTouch ? high >= fast : high >= fast - pullTol)

        reached = touched and (not requireExtension or extended)

        if reached
            st          := 2
            pbExt       := isLong ? low : high
            pullbackNow := true

    else if st == 2
        // ---- Step 6: confirmation that price is moving back in trend
        pbExt := isLong ? math.min(nz(pbExt, low), low) : math.max(nz(pbExt, high), high)

        directional = isLong ? close > open : close < open
        beyondFast  = confNeedsClose ? (isLong ? close > fast : close < fast) : true
        adxOK       = not useADX or adxVal > adxThreshold

        if directional and beyondFast and adxOK and not fridayBlocked
            ePrice = isLong ? high + entryBuf : low - entryBuf

            anchor = slMode == "Confirmation candle" ? (isLong ? low : high) :
                     slMode == "Pullback swing"      ? pbExt :
                     slMode == "200 SMA"             ? slow  : float(na)

            slPrice = slMode == "Fixed distance"
                 ? (isLong ? ePrice - fixedSL : ePrice + fixedSL)
                 : (isLong ? anchor - slBuf   : anchor + slBuf)

            risk = isLong ? ePrice - slPrice : slPrice - ePrice

            if not na(slPrice) and risk > 0
                tpPrice = isLong ? ePrice + risk * rr : ePrice - risk * rr

                eEntry     := ePrice
                eSL        := slPrice
                eTP        := tpPrice
                confirmNow := true

                if inWindow
                    qty = useRiskSizing ? (strategy.equity * riskPct / 100.0) / risk : na

                    if isLong
                        if na(qty)
                            strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, stop = ePrice)
                        else
                            strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, stop = ePrice, qty = qty)
                    else
                        if na(qty)
                            strategy.entry("S", strategy.short, stop = ePrice)
                        else
                            strategy.entry("S", strategy.short, stop = ePrice, qty = qty)

                    st        := 3
                    armedBars := 0

    else if st == 3
        // ---- Working stop order: filled, or age it out
        if strategy.position_size != 0
            // Keep dir / entry / SL / TP populated: the spec requires those
            // fields to stay readable for the whole life of the trade.
            st := 0
        else
            armedBars += 1
            if pendingBars > 0 and armedBars > pendingBars
                strategy.cancel("L")
                strategy.cancel("S")
                // The crossover may still be valid - resume hunting a pullback.
                st        := 1
                armedBars := 0
                pbExt     := isLong ? low : high
                eEntry    := na
                eSL       := na
                eTP       := na

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  WEEKEND PROTECTION  -  never carry risk across the weekend gap
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
if closeBeforeWeekend and isFriday and hour >= fridayCutoffHour
    if strategy.position_size != 0
        strategy.close_all(comment = "weekend flat")
    strategy.cancel("L")
    strategy.cancel("S")

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  EXITS  -  stop and 1:2 target ride with the position
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
if not na(eSL) and not na(eTP)
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry = "L", stop = eSL, limit = eTP)
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry = "S", stop = eSL, limit = eTP)

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  ENTRY / EXIT MARKERS  -  actual fills, not just signals
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
inPos   = strategy.position_size != 0
justIn  = inPos and not inPos[1]
justOut = not inPos and inPos[1]
wasLong = nz(strategy.position_size[1]) > 0

// Was the closing fill a target or a stop? Compare the exit price to the entry.
lastWin = strategy.closedtrades > 0 and
     strategy.closedtrades.profit(strategy.closedtrades - 1) > 0

// ---- Alert the moment an entry actually fills
if justIn
    alert("SMAX 20/200 " + (strategy.position_size > 0 ? "LONG" : "SHORT") + " ENTRY  " +
          syminfo.ticker + "  " + timeframe.period +
          "  @ " + str.tostring(strategy.position_avg_price, format.mintick) +
          "  SL " + str.tostring(eSL, format.mintick) +
          "  TP " + str.tostring(eTP, format.mintick) +
          "  ADX " + str.tostring(adxVal, "#.0"),
          alert.freq_once_per_bar)

plotshape(showMarkers and justIn and strategy.position_size > 0, "Entry Long",
     shape.labelup, location.belowbar, color.new(color.green, 0),
     text = "BUY", textcolor = color.white, size = size.small)

plotshape(showMarkers and justIn and strategy.position_size < 0, "Entry Short",
     shape.labeldown, location.abovebar, color.new(color.red, 0),
     text = "SELL", textcolor = color.white, size = size.small)

plotshape(showMarkers and justOut and wasLong, "Exit Long",
     shape.labeldown, location.abovebar,
     lastWin ? color.new(color.teal, 0) : color.new(color.maroon, 0),
     text = "EXIT", textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)

plotshape(showMarkers and justOut and not wasLong, "Exit Short",
     shape.labelup, location.belowbar,
     lastWin ? color.new(color.teal, 0) : color.new(color.maroon, 0),
     text = "EXIT", textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  VISUALS
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
plot(fast, "20 SMA",  color = color.new(color.orange, 0), linewidth = 2)
plot(slow, "200 SMA", color = color.new(color.blue,   0), linewidth = 2)

plotshape(showMarkers and bullCross, "Bullish cross", shape.triangleup,
     location.belowbar, color.new(color.green, 0), size = size.tiny)
plotshape(showMarkers and bearCross, "Bearish cross", shape.triangledown,
     location.abovebar, color.new(color.red, 0), size = size.tiny)
plotshape(showMarkers and pullbackNow, "Pullback", shape.circle,
     location.belowbar, color.new(color.yellow, 0), size = size.tiny)
plotshape(showMarkers and confirmNow, "Confirmation", shape.diamond,
     location.belowbar, color.new(color.aqua, 0), size = size.tiny)

if showLevels
    line.delete(lnE)
    line.delete(lnS)
    line.delete(lnT)
    if st == 3 and not na(eEntry)
        lnE := line.new(bar_index - 3, eEntry, bar_index + 12, eEntry,
             color = color.new(color.gray,   0), style = line.style_dashed)
        lnS := line.new(bar_index - 3, eSL,    bar_index + 12, eSL,
             color = color.new(color.red,    0), style = line.style_dotted)
        lnT := line.new(bar_index - 3, eTP,    bar_index + 12, eTP,
             color = color.new(color.green,  0), style = line.style_dotted)

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  FAILURE ANALYSIS
//  Pairs every closed trade with the conditions that were true when it
//  was ENTERED, so losers can be attributed rather than guessed at.
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
var array<float> pendAdx  = array.new_float()
var array<int>   pendHour = array.new_int()

var int   nWin = 0,  nLoss = 0
var float adxWinSum = 0.0, adxLossSum = 0.0
var int   lossLong = 0, lossShort = 0, winLong = 0, winShort = 0
var array<int> lossByHour = array.new_int(24, 0)
var array<int> winByHour  = array.new_int(24, 0)
var int   streak = 0, worstStreak = 0
var float lossRSum = 0.0
var int   seenClosed = 0

// stamp the entry conditions when a fill happens
if justIn
    array.push(pendAdx,  adxVal)
    array.push(pendHour, hour)

// harvest every newly closed trade
if strategy.closedtrades > seenClosed
    for k = seenClosed to strategy.closedtrades - 1
        pl     = strategy.closedtrades.profit(k)
        entryP = strategy.closedtrades.entry_price(k)
        exitP  = strategy.closedtrades.exit_price(k)
        isL    = str.contains(strategy.closedtrades.entry_id(k), "L")

        // NOT a ternary: Pine evaluates both branches of ?: so array.shift()
        // would still run on an empty array and raise a runtime error.
        float aAtEntry = na
        int   hAtEntry = na
        if array.size(pendAdx) > 0
            aAtEntry := array.shift(pendAdx)
        if array.size(pendHour) > 0
            hAtEntry := array.shift(pendHour)

        if pl < 0
            nLoss += 1
            streak += 1
            worstStreak := math.max(worstStreak, streak)
            adxLossSum := adxLossSum + nz(aAtEntry)
            if isL
                lossLong += 1
            else
                lossShort += 1
            if not na(hAtEntry) and hAtEntry >= 0 and hAtEntry < 24
                array.set(lossByHour, hAtEntry, array.get(lossByHour, hAtEntry) + 1)
            // realised R, using the trade's own entry-to-exit distance
            lossRSum := lossRSum + math.abs(entryP - exitP)
        else
            nWin += 1
            streak := 0
            adxWinSum := adxWinSum + nz(aAtEntry)
            if isL
                winLong += 1
            else
                winShort += 1
            if not na(hAtEntry) and hAtEntry >= 0 and hAtEntry < 24
                array.set(winByHour, hAtEntry, array.get(winByHour, hAtEntry) + 1)
    seenClosed := strategy.closedtrades

showFailPanel = input.bool(true, "Show failure analysis panel", group = gV)

var table fpanel = table.new(position.bottom_right, 2, 17,
     border_width = 1, frame_width = 1, frame_color = color.gray)

fp(int r, string k, string v, color bg) =>
    table.cell(fpanel, 0, r, k, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.tiny,
         text_halign = text.align_left,  bgcolor = color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(fpanel, 1, r, v, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.tiny,
         text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = bg)

if showFailPanel and barstate.islast
    dim = color.new(color.black, 30)
    tot = nWin + nLoss

    worstH = 0
    worstN = 0
    for i = 0 to 23
        if array.get(lossByHour, i) > worstN
            worstN := array.get(lossByHour, i)
            worstH := i

    // ---- performance, read straight off the strategy engine
    pf  = strategy.grossloss > 0 ? strategy.grossprofit / strategy.grossloss : na
    wr  = strategy.closedtrades > 0 ? strategy.wintrades * 100.0 / strategy.closedtrades : na
    fp(0, "PERFORMANCE", "", dim)
    fp(1, "Net profit", str.tostring(strategy.netprofit, "#.##"),
         strategy.netprofit >= 0 ? color.new(color.teal, 40) : color.new(color.maroon, 40))
    fp(2, "Profit factor", na(pf) ? "-" : str.tostring(pf, "#.###"),
         not na(pf) and pf >= 1 ? color.new(color.teal, 40) : color.new(color.maroon, 40))
    fp(3, "Win rate", na(wr) ? "-" : str.tostring(wr, "#.0") + "%  " +
         str.tostring(strategy.wintrades) + "/" + str.tostring(strategy.closedtrades), dim)
    fp(4, "Max drawdown", str.tostring(strategy.max_drawdown, "#.##"), dim)
    fp(5, "Friday filter", blockFridayLate ? "ON (cut " + str.tostring(fridayCutoffHour) + ":00)" : "off", dim)
    fp(6, "SL anchor", slMode, dim)

    fp(7, "FAILURE ANALYSIS", "", dim)
    fp(8, "Closed trades", str.tostring(tot), dim)
    fp(9, "Losers", str.tostring(nLoss) + (tot > 0 ? "  (" + str.tostring(nLoss * 100.0 / tot, "#.0") + "%)" : ""),
         color.new(color.maroon, 40))
    fp(10, "Avg ADX on losers",  nLoss > 0 ? str.tostring(adxLossSum / nLoss, "#.0") : "-", dim)
    fp(11, "Avg ADX on winners", nWin  > 0 ? str.tostring(adxWinSum  / nWin,  "#.0") : "-",
         color.new(color.teal, 40))
    fp(12, "Losers LONG / SHORT", str.tostring(lossLong) + " / " + str.tostring(lossShort), dim)
    fp(13, "Winners LONG / SHORT", str.tostring(winLong) + " / " + str.tostring(winShort), dim)
    fp(14, "Worst hour (losses)", worstN > 0 ? str.tostring(worstH) + ":00  x" + str.tostring(worstN) : "-", dim)
    fp(15, "Max losing streak", str.tostring(worstStreak), dim)
    fp(16, "Avg loss distance", nLoss > 0 ? str.tostring(lossRSum / nLoss, format.mintick) : "-", dim)

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
//  STATUS PANEL  -  the Step 9 readout from the specification
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ //
var table panel = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 13,
     border_width = 1, frame_width = 1, frame_color = color.gray)

// Panel row helper. Must live at global scope - Pine forbids declaring a
// function inside a conditional block.
f(int r, string k, string v) =>
    table.cell(panel, 0, r, k, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small,
         text_halign = text.align_left,  bgcolor = color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(panel, 1, r, v, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small,
         text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = color.new(color.black, 30))

if showPanel and barstate.islast
    dirTxt = dir ==  1 ? "LONG" : dir == -1 ? "SHORT" : "-"
    crsTxt = dir ==  1 ? "Bullish" : dir == -1 ? "Bearish" : "None"
    pbTxt  = (st == 2 or st == 3) ? "YES" : "NO"
    cfTxt  = st == 3 ? "YES" : "NO"

    stsTxt = strategy.position_size != 0 ? "IN TRADE" :
             st == 3 ? "ENTER" :
             (st == 1 or st == 2) ? "WAIT" : "NO TRADE"

    stsCol = stsTxt == "ENTER"    ? color.new(color.green, 0) :
             stsTxt == "IN TRADE" ? color.new(color.blue,  0) :
             stsTxt == "WAIT"     ? color.new(color.orange,0) : color.new(color.gray, 0)

    f(0,  "Direction",    dirTxt)
    f(1,  "Timeframe",    timeframe.period)
    f(2,  str.tostring(fastLen) + " SMA",  str.tostring(fast, format.mintick))
    f(3,  str.tostring(slowLen) + " SMA",  str.tostring(slow, format.mintick))
    f(4,  "Crossover",    crsTxt)
    f(5,  "Pullback",     pbTxt)
    f(6,  "Confirmation", cfTxt)
    f(7,  "Entry",        na(eEntry) ? "-" : str.tostring(eEntry, format.mintick))
    f(8,  "Stop Loss",    na(eSL)    ? "-" : str.tostring(eSL,    format.mintick))
    f(9,  "Target",       na(eTP)    ? "-" : str.tostring(eTP,    format.mintick))
    f(10, "Risk:Reward",  "1:" + str.tostring(rr, "#.#"))

    adxTxt = str.tostring(adxVal, "#.0") + (useADX ? (adxVal > adxThreshold ? "  OK" : "  LOW") : "")
    table.cell(panel, 0, 11, "ADX(" + str.tostring(adxLen) + ")", text_color = color.white,
         text_size = size.small, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(panel, 1, 11, adxTxt, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small,
         text_halign = text.align_right,
         bgcolor = not useADX ? color.new(color.black, 30)
              : adxVal > adxThreshold ? color.new(color.green, 40) : color.new(color.red, 40))

    table.cell(panel, 0, 12, "Trade Status", text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small,
         text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = color.new(color.black, 30))
    table.cell(panel, 1, 12, stsTxt, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small,
         text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = stsCol)

//@version=5
strategy("SimpleSMA18 Strategy (MQL5 port)", overlay=true,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=10,
     pyramiding=0, calc_on_every_tick=false, process_orders_on_close=false)

// ================= Inputs =================
fastLen     = input.int(18,  "Fast MA Period",  group="Signal")
trendLen    = input.int(200, "Trend MA Period", group="Signal")
volLen      = input.int(20,  "Volume MA Period",group="Signal")
swingStr    = input.int(2,   "Swing Strength",  group="Signal")
bufferTicks = input.int(20,  "Entry Buffer (ticks)", group="Signal")

enableBE    = input.bool(false, "Enable Break-Even", group="Break-Even")
beTrigger   = input.int(10000, "Break-Even Trigger (ticks)", group="Break-Even")
beOffset    = input.int(5000,  "Break-Even Offset (ticks)",  group="Break-Even")

protMode      = input.string("None", "Protection Mode", options=["None","Swing","Chandelier","Trailing"], group="Protection")
protStartMode = input.string("After Points", "Protection Start Mode", options=["Immediately","After Points"], group="Protection")
protStart     = input.int(2000,  "Protection Start Points (ticks)", group="Protection")
swingBuf      = input.int(200,   "Swing Buffer (ticks)", group="Protection")
chLookback    = input.int(22,    "Chandelier Lookback",  group="Protection")
atrLen        = input.int(22,    "ATR Period",   group="Protection")
atrMult       = input.float(3.0, "ATR Multiplier", group="Protection")
trailStart    = input.int(1000,  "Trailing Start (ticks)", group="Protection")
trailDist     = input.int(500,   "Trailing Distance (ticks)", group="Protection")
trailStep     = input.int(200,   "Trailing Step (ticks)", group="Protection")

enablePartial = input.bool(true,  "Enable Partial Close", group="Partial Close")
partialTrig   = input.int(6000,  "Partial Close Trigger (ticks)", group="Partial Close")
partialPct    = input.float(50.0,"Partial Close Percent", minval=1, maxval=99, group="Partial Close")

pointOverride = input.float(0.0, "MT5 Point Size (0 = auto mintick)", group="Scaling")
pt = pointOverride > 0 ? pointOverride : syminfo.mintick

useTP     = input.bool(true, "Use Take-Profit target (Reward:Risk)", group="Targets & Alerts")
rrTarget  = input.float(2.0, "Reward : Risk", step=0.5, group="Targets & Alerts")
alertsOn  = input.bool(true, "Send Telegram alerts",  group="Targets & Alerts")
tgChatId  = input.string("", "Telegram chat_id",      group="Targets & Alerts")

// ================= Indicators =================
ma18   = ta.sma(close, fastLen)
ma200  = ta.sma(close, trendLen)
avgVol = ta.sma(volume, volLen)
atrV   = ta.atr(atrLen)
plot(ma18,  "MA 18",  color=color.new(color.aqua, 0))
plot(ma200, "MA 200", color=color.new(color.orange, 0))

// ================= Swing points =================
var float lastSwingLow  = na
var float lastSwingHigh = na
pl = ta.pivotlow(low,  swingStr, swingStr)
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, swingStr, swingStr)
if not na(pl)
    lastSwingLow := pl
if not na(ph)
    lastSwingHigh := ph

// ================= Entry signals =================
buySignal  = close > ma200 and close > ma18 and close[1] > ma18[1] and volume > avgVol
sellSignal = close < ma200 and close < ma18 and close[1] < ma18[1] and volume > avgVol

flat = strategy.position_size == 0
var bool longPending  = false
var bool shortPending = false

if longPending and close < ma18
    strategy.cancel("Long")
    longPending := false
if shortPending and close > ma18
    strategy.cancel("Short")
    shortPending := false

if strategy.position_size != 0
    longPending  := false
    shortPending := false

if flat and not longPending and not shortPending
    if buySignal and not na(lastSwingLow)
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, stop = high + bufferTicks * pt)
        strategy.exit("Long-Prot", "Long", stop = lastSwingLow)
        longPending := true
    else if sellSignal and not na(lastSwingHigh)
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, stop = low - bufferTicks * pt)
        strategy.exit("Short-Prot", "Short", stop = lastSwingHigh)
        shortPending := true

// ================= Targets + Telegram alerts + entry labels =================
var float tpLevel   = na
var float slAtEntry = na
longOpened  = strategy.position_size > 0 and strategy.position_size[1] <= 0
shortOpened = strategy.position_size < 0 and strategy.position_size[1] >= 0
justFlat    = strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] != 0
tgWrap(txt) => '{"chat_id":"' + tgChatId + '","text":"' + txt + '"}'

if longOpened
    slAtEntry := nz(lastSwingLow, low)
    risk = strategy.position_avg_price - slAtEntry
    tpLevel := (useTP and risk > 0) ? strategy.position_avg_price + rrTarget * risk : na
    if alertsOn
        m = "🟢 LONG " + syminfo.ticker + " " + timeframe.period + "  Entry " + str.tostring(strategy.position_avg_price, format.mintick) + "  SL " + str.tostring(slAtEntry, format.mintick) + (na(tpLevel) ? "" : "  TP " + str.tostring(tpLevel, format.mintick))
        alert(tgWrap(m), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    label.new(bar_index, low, "LONG " + str.tostring(strategy.position_avg_price, format.mintick) + "\nSL " + str.tostring(slAtEntry, format.mintick) + (na(tpLevel) ? "" : "\nTP " + str.tostring(tpLevel, format.mintick)), yloc=yloc.belowbar, style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.green, 10), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)

if shortOpened
    slAtEntry := nz(lastSwingHigh, high)
    risk = slAtEntry - strategy.position_avg_price
    tpLevel := (useTP and risk > 0) ? strategy.position_avg_price - rrTarget * risk : na
    if alertsOn
        m = "🔴 SHORT " + syminfo.ticker + " " + timeframe.period + "  Entry " + str.tostring(strategy.position_avg_price, format.mintick) + "  SL " + str.tostring(slAtEntry, format.mintick) + (na(tpLevel) ? "" : "  TP " + str.tostring(tpLevel, format.mintick))
        alert(tgWrap(m), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    label.new(bar_index, high, "SHORT " + str.tostring(strategy.position_avg_price, format.mintick) + "\nSL " + str.tostring(slAtEntry, format.mintick) + (na(tpLevel) ? "" : "\nTP " + str.tostring(tpLevel, format.mintick)), yloc=yloc.abovebar, style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.red, 10), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)

if justFlat
    if alertsOn
        pnl = strategy.closedtrades > 0 ? strategy.closedtrades.profit(strategy.closedtrades - 1) : 0.0
        m = "⚪ CLOSED " + syminfo.ticker + " " + timeframe.period + "  Px " + str.tostring(close, format.mintick) + "  lastTradePnL " + str.tostring(pnl, "#.##")
        alert(tgWrap(m), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    tpLevel   := na
    slAtEntry := na

// ================= Hard exit on MA18 cross =================
if strategy.position_size > 0 and close <= ma18
    strategy.close("Long", comment="MA18 exit")
if strategy.position_size < 0 and close >= ma18
    strategy.close("Short", comment="MA18 exit")

// ================= Stop management (Break-even + Protection + Partial) =====
var float stopLvl = na
var bool  partialDone = false
if strategy.position_size > 0
    ep = strategy.position_avg_price
    stopLvl := na(stopLvl) ? lastSwingLow : stopLvl
    profitPts = (close - ep) / pt
    if enablePartial and not partialDone and profitPts >= partialTrig
        strategy.close("Long", qty_percent = partialPct, comment = "Partial")
        partialDone := true
    if enableBE and profitPts >= beTrigger
        stopLvl := math.max(nz(stopLvl, ep + beOffset * pt), ep + beOffset * pt)
    active = protStartMode == "Immediately" or profitPts >= protStart
    if active and protMode == "Swing" and not na(lastSwingLow)
        ns = lastSwingLow - swingBuf * pt
        stopLvl := math.max(nz(stopLvl, ns), ns)
    if active and protMode == "Chandelier"
        ns = ta.highest(high, chLookback) - atrV * atrMult
        stopLvl := math.max(nz(stopLvl, ns), ns)
    if active and protMode == "Trailing" and profitPts >= trailStart
        ns = close - trailDist * pt
        if na(stopLvl) or (ns - stopLvl) >= trailStep * pt
            stopLvl := math.max(nz(stopLvl, ns), ns)
    if not na(stopLvl)
        strategy.exit("Long-Prot", "Long", stop = stopLvl, limit = tpLevel)
else if strategy.position_size < 0
    ep = strategy.position_avg_price
    stopLvl := na(stopLvl) ? lastSwingHigh : stopLvl
    profitPts = (ep - close) / pt
    if enablePartial and not partialDone and profitPts >= partialTrig
        strategy.close("Short", qty_percent = partialPct, comment = "Partial")
        partialDone := true
    if enableBE and profitPts >= beTrigger
        stopLvl := math.min(nz(stopLvl, ep - beOffset * pt), ep - beOffset * pt)
    active = protStartMode == "Immediately" or profitPts >= protStart
    if active and protMode == "Swing" and not na(lastSwingHigh)
        ns = lastSwingHigh + swingBuf * pt
        stopLvl := math.min(nz(stopLvl, ns), ns)
    if active and protMode == "Chandelier"
        ns = ta.lowest(low, chLookback) + atrV * atrMult
        stopLvl := math.min(nz(stopLvl, ns), ns)
    if active and protMode == "Trailing" and profitPts >= trailStart
        ns = close + trailDist * pt
        if na(stopLvl) or (stopLvl - ns) >= trailStep * pt
            stopLvl := math.min(nz(stopLvl, ns), ns)
    if not na(stopLvl)
        strategy.exit("Short-Prot", "Short", stop = stopLvl, limit = tpLevel)
else
    stopLvl := na
    partialDone := false

// ================= Visual SL / TP lines =================
plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? tpLevel : na, "Target (TP)", color=color.new(color.green, 0), style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)
plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? stopLvl  : na, "Stop (SL)",  color=color.new(color.red,   0), style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)

// ================= "Criteria matched" markers on the chart =================
buySetup  = buySignal  and not buySignal[1]  and strategy.position_size == 0
sellSetup = sellSignal and not sellSignal[1] and strategy.position_size == 0
plotshape(buySetup,  title="Long criteria",  style=shape.triangleup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.lime,   0), size=size.small, text="LONG")
plotshape(sellSetup, title="Short criteria", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.orange, 0), size=size.small, text="SHORT")
bgcolor(buySetup ? color.new(color.green, 85) : sellSetup ? color.new(color.red, 85) : na)

//@version=6
// =============================================================================
//  SRK SMA18 Bot v11  -  line-for-line Pine port of SimpleSMA18Bot_v11.mq5
//  Source EA : MQL5/Experts/Advisors/SimpleSMA18Bot_v11.mq5   (EA version 1.20)
//
//  MT5 GROUND TRUTH (XAUUSD, M15, 0.01 lot, 2024-01-02 -> 2026-07-10):
//      trades 3597 | net +851.51 | PF 1.075 | win 64.05% | closed-trade DD 344.96
//      exits: 2458 StopLoss/Protection, 1139 EA(MA18/MaxLoss/Partial)
//  The table (top-right) prints TradingView numbers next to these so the port
//  can be verified on the chart.
//
//  BAR MAPPING USED THROUGHOUT:  MT5 bar[N]  ==  Pine [N-1]
//  The EA acts on the first tick of a new bar, so its "bar 1" (last closed bar)
//  is the bar Pine has just closed. Every rule below is written to that mapping,
//  which is also why process_orders_on_close stays false: an EA order sent on
//  the first tick of a new bar fills at that bar open == Pine next-bar-open.
//
//  KNOWN DIVERGENCES FROM MT5 (read before comparing numbers):
//   1. VOLUME. The EA uses MT5 tick volume. TradingView volume on XAUUSD comes
//      from a different feed, so the "volume > 20-SMA" filter selects DIFFERENT
//      bars. This is a data difference, not a porting bug. Set "Volume filter"
//      off on both sides for a like-for-like comparison.
//   2. Break-even / partial / protection-start triggers are evaluated on the bar
//      EXTREME (high/low), so they arm on the same bar MT5 arms them, but the
//      resulting stop only becomes active on the next bar.
//   3. Spread / commission / slippage are 0 here. Set them in Properties to
//      match the MT5 test.
// =============================================================================

strategy(
     title                   = "SRK SMA18 Bot v11 (MT5 port)",
     shorttitle              = "SMA18 v11",
     overlay                 = true,
     initial_capital         = 10000,
     default_qty_type        = strategy.fixed,
     default_qty_value       = 1,
     pyramiding              = 0,
     calc_on_every_tick      = false,
     process_orders_on_close = false,
     currency                = currency.USD,
     max_labels_count        = 500,
     max_lines_count         = 500)

// ============================== INPUTS =======================================
// Group and label names mirror the MT5 Inputs tab 1:1 so values copy straight over.

var string G0 = "0 - Chart & sizing"
eaTF     = input.timeframe("15",  "TimeFrame (EA input)",        group = G0, tooltip = "The EA TimeFrame input. This does NOT resample the chart - it only warns when the chart timeframe differs, so the port always runs on true chart bars (no repainting).")
lotSize  = input.float(0.01, "LotSize (MT5 lots)",  minval = 0.01, step = 0.01, group = G0)
unitsLot = input.float(100,  "Units per 1.00 lot",  minval = 1,                 group = G0, tooltip = "XAUUSD = 100 oz per lot, so 0.01 lot = 1 unit = 1 TradingView contract. Set this to the contract size of the symbol to make P&L match MT5 currency-for-currency.")
lotStep  = input.float(0.01, "Broker volume step",  minval = 0.001, step = 0.01, group = G0)
lotMin   = input.float(0.01, "Broker min volume",   minval = 0.001, step = 0.01, group = G0)
ptIn     = input.float(0.01, "_Point size (0 = chart mintick)", minval = 0, step = 0.001, group = G0, tooltip = "MT5 _Point for 2-digit XAUUSD is 0.01. EVERY Points input below is multiplied by this.")
lookbackDays = input.int(60, "Backtest window (days back from now, 0 = all data)", minval = 0, group = G0, tooltip = "Restricts trading to the last N days. Done inside the script so it works on any TradingView plan - the Strategy Tester date range needs a paid Deep Backtesting subscription. 60 = last 2 months. The window rolls forward automatically.")

var string G1 = "1 - Signal"
fastLen  = input.int(18,  "FastMAPeriod",      minval = 1, group = G1)
trendLen = input.int(200, "TrendMAPeriod",     minval = 1, group = G1)
volLen   = input.int(20,  "VolumeMAPeriod",    minval = 1, group = G1)
useVol   = input.bool(true, "Volume filter enabled", group = G1, tooltip = "OFF = ignore the volume>average rule. Turn it OFF on both MT5 and TradingView for a like-for-like comparison, because tick volume differs between feeds.")
swingStr = input.int(2,   "SwingStrength",     minval = 1, maxval = 20, group = G1)
bufPts   = input.int(11,  "EntryBufferPoints", minval = 0, group = G1)

var string G2 = "2 - Break-even"
enableBE = input.bool(false, "EnableBreakEven",          group = G2)
bePts    = input.int(500,    "BreakEvenTriggerPoints",   minval = 0, group = G2)
beOff    = input.int(10,     "BreakEvenOffsetPoints",    minval = 0, group = G2)

var string G3 = "3 - Follow-through & max loss"
F_OFF   = "Off - no follow-through exit"
F_NEXT  = "1st candle after entry must break the entry candle high/low"
F_STALL = "Close on first candle that fails to make a new high/low"
F_TRIG  = "Next candle must exceed the breakout trigger (entry) level"
followMode = input.string(F_OFF, "FollowMode", options = [F_OFF, F_NEXT, F_STALL, F_TRIG], group = G3)

M_OFF   = "Off - SL = swing only"
M_CAP   = "SL = tighter of swing vs entry +/- MaxLossPoints"
M_REPL  = "SL = entry +/- MaxLossPoints (ignore swing)"
M_RULE  = "Cap loss at MaxLossPoints only during follow-through window"
maxLossMode = input.string(M_OFF, "MaxLossMode", options = [M_OFF, M_CAP, M_REPL, M_RULE], group = G3)
maxLossPts  = input.int(2000, "MaxLossPoints", minval = 0, group = G3)
fixWindowBug = input.bool(false, "Close max-loss window even when FollowMode = Off", group = G3, tooltip = "EA BEHAVIOUR (default, unchecked): with FollowMode=Off the EA never clears gWindowOpen, so MaxLossMode = cap-during-window silently acts as a hard stop for the WHOLE trade. Tick this to close the window after the first post-entry bar as the mode name implies.")

var string G4 = "4 - Profit protection"
P_NONE = "PROTECTION_NONE"
P_SWNG = "PROTECTION_SWING"
P_CHAN = "PROTECTION_CHANDELIER"
P_TRAL = "PROTECTION_TRAILING"
protMode = input.string(P_TRAL, "ProtectionMode", options = [P_NONE, P_SWNG, P_CHAN, P_TRAL], group = G4)
S_IMM  = "START_IMMEDIATELY"
S_PTS  = "START_AFTER_POINTS"
protStartMode = input.string(S_IMM, "ProtectionStartMode", options = [S_IMM, S_PTS], group = G4)
protStartPts  = input.int(2000, "ProtectionStartPoints", minval = 0, group = G4)
swingBufPts   = input.int(200,  "SwingBufferPoints",     minval = 0, group = G4)
chLb          = input.int(22,   "ChandelierLookback",    minval = 1, group = G4)
atrLen        = input.int(22,   "ATRPeriod",             minval = 1, group = G4)
atrMult       = input.float(3.0,"ATRMultiplier",         minval = 0, step = 0.1, group = G4)
trailStartPts = input.int(500,  "TrailingStartPoints",   minval = 0, group = G4)
trailDistPts  = input.int(200,  "TrailingDistancePoints",minval = 1, group = G4)
trailStepPts  = input.int(100,  "TrailingStepPoints",    minval = 0, group = G4)
T_NATIVE  = "Native intrabar (matches MT5 tick trailing)"
T_BARSTEP = "Bar close + TrailingStepPoints gate"
trailEngine = input.string(T_NATIVE, "Trailing engine", options = [T_NATIVE, T_BARSTEP], group = G4, tooltip = "MT5 re-prices the trailing stop on EVERY TICK from the live bid. Native = the TradingView intrabar trailing stop, which reproduces that, but it ignores TrailingStepPoints (a 100-point step on gold is $1 of lag). Bar close = exact EA arithmetic including the step gate, but re-priced only once per bar.")

var string G5 = "5 - Partial close"
enablePartial  = input.bool(false, "EnablePartialClose",        group = G5)
partialTrigPts = input.int(6000,   "PartialCloseTriggerPoints", minval = 0, group = G5)
partialPct     = input.float(50.0, "PartialClosePercent", minval = 1, maxval = 99, step = 1, group = G5)

var string G6 = "6 - Display"
showTable   = input.bool(true, "Show verification table",  group = G6)
showLevels  = input.bool(true, "Show entry / stop levels", group = G6)
showSignals = input.bool(true, "Show signal markers",      group = G6)
showMAs     = input.bool(true, "Show moving averages",     group = G6)

var string G7 = "7 - MT5 benchmark column"
mLabel  = input.string("MT5 Apr-Jun 26", "Column header",    group = G7, tooltip = "Paste the numbers from your MT5 Strategy Tester run here and the table shows them next to TradingView's, so the two engines can be compared at a glance. Defaults are the SMA18_trades_XAUUSD.csv run of 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-04.")
mTrades = input.string("291",     "MT5 trades",        group = G7)
mNet    = input.string("-133.93", "MT5 net profit",    group = G7)
mPF     = input.string("0.895",   "MT5 profit factor", group = G7)
mWin    = input.string("77.32",   "MT5 win %",         group = G7)
mDD     = input.string("187.02",  "MT5 max DD",        group = G7)
mAvg    = input.string("-0.4602", "MT5 avg trade",     group = G7)

// ============================ DERIVED CONSTANTS ==============================
pt  = ptIn > 0 ? ptIn : syminfo.mintick
qty = lotSize * unitsLot

// ============================== INDICATORS ===================================
// EA: iMA(SMA, PRICE_CLOSE) at shift 1/2, iATR at shift 1, volume average of
// bars 1..N. All of those land on the current Pine bar under the bar mapping.
ma18   = ta.sma(close,  fastLen)
ma200  = ta.sma(close,  trendLen)
avgVol = ta.sma(volume, volLen)
atrV   = ta.atr(atrLen)
// Hoisted out of the Chandelier branch below: ta.* series must be evaluated on
// EVERY bar or their internal state desyncs (TradingView warns about this when
// they sit inside a ternary or a conditional block).
chHigh = ta.highest(high, chLb)
chLow  = ta.lowest(low,  chLb)

plot(showMAs ? ma18  : na, "MA Fast",  color = color.new(#26C6DA, 0), linewidth = 2)
plot(showMAs ? ma200 : na, "MA Trend", color = color.new(#FFA726, 0), linewidth = 2)

// ===================== SWING DETECTION (GetSwingLow / GetSwingHigh) ==========
// The EA scans MT5 bars SwingStrength+1 .. 100 and returns the FIRST bar whose
// low is STRICTLY lower than the SwingStrength bars on each side; if nothing
// qualifies inside that 100-bar window it falls back to iLow(bar 1).
// In Pine that is: test offset swingStr on every bar, remember the newest hit,
// and fall back to the current bar low once the newest hit ages past offset 99.
isSwingLow(int sw) =>
    float c  = low[sw]
    bool  ok = not na(c)
    if ok
        for i = 1 to sw
            if na(low[sw + i]) or low[sw + i] <= c or low[sw - i] <= c
                ok := false
                break
    ok

isSwingHigh(int sw) =>
    float c  = high[sw]
    bool  ok = not na(c)
    if ok
        for i = 1 to sw
            if na(high[sw + i]) or high[sw + i] >= c or high[sw - i] >= c
                ok := false
                break
    ok

var float swLowVal  = na
var int   swLowBar  = na
var float swHighVal = na
var int   swHighBar = na

if isSwingLow(swingStr)
    swLowVal := low[swingStr]
    swLowBar := bar_index - swingStr
if isSwingHigh(swingStr)
    swHighVal := high[swingStr]
    swHighBar := bar_index - swingStr

swingLow  = (not na(swLowBar)  and bar_index - swLowBar  <= 99) ? swLowVal  : low
swingHigh = (not na(swHighBar) and bar_index - swHighBar <= 99) ? swHighVal : high

// ======================= ENTRY SIGNALS (BuySignal / SellSignal) ==============
volOK   = not useVol or volume > avgVol
buySig  = close > ma200 and close > ma18 and close[1] > ma18[1] and volOK
sellSig = close < ma200 and close < ma18 and close[1] < ma18[1] and volOK

// =============================== STATE =======================================
var bool  pendL        = false
var bool  pendS        = false
var float pendEntry    = na
var float pendSL       = na

var int   entryBar     = na
var float entryPx      = na
var float curSL        = na
var bool  partialDone  = false
var bool  windowOpen   = false
var float runProfitPts = 0.0

inPos   = strategy.opentrades > 0
isLong  = strategy.position_size > 0

// warm-up guard: the EA needs the 200 SMA plus a 100-bar swing window
ready = bar_index > math.max(trendLen, 100) + swingStr + 2
// rolling backtest window (indicators still warm up on the bars before it)
inWindow = lookbackDays == 0 or time >= timenow - lookbackDays * 86400000

// ------- new-trade detection (survives partial closes) -----------------------
curEntryBar = inPos ? strategy.opentrades.entry_bar_index(0) : na
isNewTrade  = inPos and (na(entryBar) or curEntryBar != entryBar)

if isNewTrade
    entryBar     := curEntryBar
    entryPx      := strategy.opentrades.entry_price(0)
    curSL        := pendSL
    partialDone  := false
    windowOpen   := true
    runProfitPts := 0.0

if inPos
    pendL := false
    pendS := false
    // Favourable excursion in points. For a STOP entry the bar extreme can only
    // occur at or after the fill, so even on the entry bar this is exact.
    thisBest     = isLong ? (high - entryPx) / pt : (entryPx - low) / pt
    runProfitPts := math.max(runProfitPts, thisBest)

// ================ ManageFollowThrough()  (EA runs this first) ================
followExit = false
if inPos and ready
    age = bar_index - entryBar
    if followMode != F_OFF and age >= 1
        if followMode == F_STALL
            made = isLong ? high > high[1] : low < low[1]
            if not made
                followExit := true
            windowOpen := false
        else if age == 1 and windowOpen
            ref      = followMode == F_TRIG ? entryPx : (isLong ? high[1] : low[1])
            followed = isLong ? high > ref : low < ref
            if not followed
                followExit := true
            windowOpen := false
    else if followMode == F_OFF and fixWindowBug and age >= 1
        windowOpen := false

if followExit
    strategy.close_all(comment = "NoFollow")

// ======================= ManageOpenPositions() ===============================
// EA order: exit signal (then return) -> partial -> break-even -> protection.
maExit = inPos and not followExit and ready and (isLong ? close <= ma18 : close >= ma18)
if maExit
    strategy.close_all(comment = "MA18 exit")

protActive = protStartMode == S_IMM or runProfitPts >= protStartPts

if inPos and not followExit and not maExit and ready
    // ---- ManagePartialClose(): the EA rounds the close volume down to the lot
    //      step and needs one min lot left over. With LotSize 0.01 that is
    //      impossible, so the EA sets PartialClosed=true and never partials.
    //      Reproduced exactly rather than silently "fixed".
    if enablePartial and not partialDone and runProfitPts >= partialTrigPts
        closeLots = math.floor(lotSize * partialPct / 100.0 / lotStep) * lotStep
        if closeLots >= lotMin and lotSize - closeLots >= lotMin
            strategy.close(isLong ? "L" : "S", qty_percent = closeLots / lotSize * 100.0, comment = "Partial")
        partialDone := true

    // ---- ManageBreakEven() ----
    if enableBE and runProfitPts >= bePts
        beLvl = isLong ? entryPx + beOff * pt : entryPx - beOff * pt
        curSL := isLong ? math.max(nz(curSL, beLvl), beLvl) : math.min(nz(curSL, beLvl), beLvl)

    // ---- ManageProtection(); ModifyStopLoss() only ever ratchets ----
    if protActive
        if protMode == P_SWNG
            ns = isLong ? swingLow - swingBufPts * pt : swingHigh + swingBufPts * pt
            curSL := isLong ? math.max(nz(curSL, ns), ns) : math.min(nz(curSL, ns), ns)
        else if protMode == P_CHAN and atrV > 0
            ns = isLong ? chHigh - atrV * atrMult : chLow + atrV * atrMult
            curSL := isLong ? math.max(nz(curSL, ns), ns) : math.min(nz(curSL, ns), ns)
        else if protMode == P_TRAL and trailEngine == T_BARSTEP and runProfitPts >= trailStartPts
            ns = isLong ? close - trailDistPts * pt : close + trailDistPts * pt
            improved = na(curSL) or (isLong ? ns - curSL >= trailStepPts * pt : curSL - ns >= trailStepPts * pt)
            if improved
                curSL := isLong ? math.max(nz(curSL, ns), ns) : math.min(nz(curSL, ns), ns)

// ---------------- effective stop, incl. MAXLOSS cap-during-window ------------
effSL = curSL
if inPos and maxLossMode == M_RULE and windowOpen and maxLossPts > 0
    cap = isLong ? entryPx - maxLossPts * pt : entryPx + maxLossPts * pt
    effSL := isLong ? math.max(nz(effSL, cap), cap) : math.min(nz(effSL, cap), cap)

// ------------------------------- exit order ---------------------------------
useNativeTrail = protMode == P_TRAL and trailEngine == T_NATIVE and protActive
actPts    = protStartMode == S_PTS ? math.max(protStartPts, trailStartPts) : trailStartPts
trailPx   = isLong ? entryPx + actPts * pt : entryPx - actPts * pt
trailTick = math.max(1, math.round(trailDistPts * pt / syminfo.mintick))

if inPos and not followExit and not maExit and not na(effSL)
    if useNativeTrail
        strategy.exit("X", from_entry = isLong ? "L" : "S", stop = effSL, trail_price = trailPx, trail_offset = trailTick)
    else
        strategy.exit("X", from_entry = isLong ? "L" : "S", stop = effSL)

// -------------------------- flat: reset per-trade state ----------------------
if not inPos
    partialDone  := false
    windowOpen   := false
    curSL        := na
    entryBar     := na
    runProfitPts := 0.0

// ======================= NEW-BAR ORDER LOGIC (OnTick tail) ===================
// EA: if a pending order exists -> only check invalidation, then return.
//     if a position exists -> return. Otherwise place ONE stop order.
// A single EA OnTick can close a position AND arm the opposite order (the exit
// runs before HasOpenPosition() is re-tested), so a bar that fires an exit
// signal is treated as flat here too: the market close executes on the next
// open, before any stop order can trigger.
exitNow = maExit or followExit
if (not inPos or exitNow) and ready and inWindow
    if pendL
        if close < ma18                 // PendingBuyInvalidated()
            strategy.cancel("L")
            pendL     := false
            pendEntry := na
    else if pendS
        if close > ma18                 // PendingSellInvalidated()
            strategy.cancel("S")
            pendS     := false
            pendEntry := na
    else if buySig
        e  = high + bufPts * pt
        sl = maxLossMode == M_REPL ? e - maxLossPts * pt : maxLossMode == M_CAP ? math.max(swingLow, e - maxLossPts * pt) : swingLow
        strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, qty = qty, stop = e, comment = "SMA18 Entry")
        strategy.exit("X", "L", stop = sl)
        pendEntry := e
        pendSL    := sl
        pendL     := true
    else if sellSig
        e  = low - bufPts * pt
        sl = maxLossMode == M_REPL ? e + maxLossPts * pt : maxLossMode == M_CAP ? math.min(swingHigh, e + maxLossPts * pt) : swingHigh
        strategy.entry("S", strategy.short, qty = qty, stop = e, comment = "SMA18 Sell")
        strategy.exit("X", "S", stop = sl)
        pendEntry := e
        pendSL    := sl
        pendS     := true

// ================================ VISUALS ====================================
armed = not inPos and (pendL or pendS)
plot(showLevels and armed ? pendEntry : na, "Pending stop entry", color = color.new(#B39DDB, 0), style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(showLevels and armed ? pendSL    : na, "Pending SL",         color = color.new(#EF9A9A, 0), style = plot.style_linebr)
plot(showLevels and inPos ? effSL     : na, "Active SL",          color = color.new(#EF5350, 0), style = plot.style_linebr, linewidth = 2)

setupL = buySig  and not buySig[1]  and not inPos and not pendL and ready
setupS = sellSig and not sellSig[1] and not inPos and not pendS and ready
plotshape(showSignals and setupL, "Long setup",  shape.triangleup,   location.belowbar, color.new(#26A69A, 0), size = size.tiny)
plotshape(showSignals and setupS, "Short setup", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.new(#EF5350, 0), size = size.tiny)

// ---- timeframe guard -------------------------------------------------------
if barstate.islast and timeframe.period != eaTF
    label.new(bar_index, high, "TIMEFRAME MISMATCH\nEA input = " + eaTF + "   chart = " + timeframe.period, style = label.style_label_down, color = color.new(color.red, 0), textcolor = color.white, size = size.small)

// ---- verification table: TradingView vs the MT5 run ------------------------
var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 3, 7, border_width = 1)
if showTable and barstate.islast
    pf = strategy.grossloss > 0 ? strategy.grossprofit / strategy.grossloss : 0.0
    wr = strategy.closedtrades > 0 ? 100.0 * strategy.wintrades / strategy.closedtrades : 0.0
    av = strategy.closedtrades > 0 ? strategy.netprofit / strategy.closedtrades : 0.0
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, "metric",         bgcolor = #263238, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(t, 1, 0, "TradingView",    bgcolor = #263238, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(t, 2, 0, mLabel, bgcolor = #263238, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)
    rows = array.from("trades", "net profit", "profit factor", "win %", "max DD", "avg trade")
    tv   = array.from(str.tostring(strategy.closedtrades), str.tostring(strategy.netprofit, "#.##"), str.tostring(pf, "#.###"), str.tostring(wr, "#.##"), str.tostring(strategy.max_drawdown, "#.##"), str.tostring(av, "#.####"))
    mt   = array.from(mTrades, mNet, mPF, mWin, mDD, mAvg)
    for i = 0 to 5
        table.cell(t, 0, i + 1, array.get(rows, i), bgcolor = #37474F, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)
        table.cell(t, 1, i + 1, array.get(tv, i),   bgcolor = #455A64, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)
        table.cell(t, 2, i + 1, array.get(mt, i),   bgcolor = #455A64, text_color = #B0BEC5,     text_size = size.small)

// ---- alerts ----------------------------------------------------------------
// Deliberately none here: alertcondition() has no effect inside a strategy, and
// strategy alerts are configured from the Strategy Tester ("Add alert on
// SMA18 v11"). For chart alerts / webhooks use the companion indicator,
// srk_sma18_v11_indicator.pine, which runs the identical state machine.

name: SRK SMA18 Bot v11 - Signal Engine
source:
//@version=6
// =============================================================================
//  SRK SMA18 Bot v11 - SIGNAL ENGINE (indicator)
//  Same rule set as srk_sma18_v11_strategy.pine / SimpleSMA18Bot_v11.mq5,
//  packaged as an indicator so it can drive TradingView alerts and webhooks.
//
//  NON-REPAINTING BY CONSTRUCTION: every state transition is gated on
//  barstate.isconfirmed, so nothing changes once a bar has closed. On the
//  live bar the panel shows the state as of the last CLOSED bar.
//
//  State machine (mirrors the EA exactly):
//    FLAT -> armed stop order (cancelled when close crosses back through MA18)
//         -> filled when price trades through the stop level
//         -> managed by SL / break-even / protection / follow-through
//         -> exit on stop hit, MA18 close-back, or follow-through failure
//  One order or one position at a time - never both, never two.
// =============================================================================

indicator("SRK SMA18 Bot v11 - Signal Engine", "SMA18 v11 Signals", overlay = true,
     max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500)

// ================================ INPUTS =====================================
var string G0 = "0 - Chart & sizing"
eaTF   = input.timeframe("15", "TimeFrame (EA input)", group = G0, tooltip = "Warning only - the script always uses real chart bars so it cannot repaint.")
ptIn   = input.float(0.01, "_Point size (0 = chart mintick)", minval = 0, step = 0.001, group = G0, tooltip = "MT5 _Point for 2-digit XAUUSD is 0.01. Every Points input below is multiplied by this.")
lookbackDays = input.int(60, "Stats window (days back from now, 0 = all data)", minval = 0, group = G0, tooltip = "Restricts the simulated trades in the status panel to the last N days. 60 = last 2 months. Live signalling is unaffected.")

var string G1 = "1 - Signal"
fastLen  = input.int(18,  "FastMAPeriod",  minval = 1, group = G1)
trendLen = input.int(200, "TrendMAPeriod", minval = 1, group = G1)
volLen   = input.int(20,  "VolumeMAPeriod",minval = 1, group = G1)
useVol   = input.bool(true, "Volume filter enabled", group = G1, tooltip = "MT5 tick volume and TradingView volume come from different feeds. Turn this off on both sides when comparing results.")
swingStr = input.int(2,   "SwingStrength", minval = 1, maxval = 20, group = G1)
bufPts   = input.int(11,  "EntryBufferPoints", minval = 0, group = G1)

var string G2 = "2 - Break-even"
enableBE = input.bool(false, "EnableBreakEven",        group = G2)
bePts    = input.int(500,    "BreakEvenTriggerPoints", minval = 0, group = G2)
beOff    = input.int(10,     "BreakEvenOffsetPoints",  minval = 0, group = G2)

var string G3 = "3 - Follow-through & max loss"
F_OFF   = "Off - no follow-through exit"
F_NEXT  = "1st candle after entry must break the entry candle high/low"
F_STALL = "Close on first candle that fails to make a new high/low"
F_TRIG  = "Next candle must exceed the breakout trigger (entry) level"
followMode = input.string(F_OFF, "FollowMode", options = [F_OFF, F_NEXT, F_STALL, F_TRIG], group = G3)
M_OFF  = "Off - SL = swing only"
M_CAP  = "SL = tighter of swing vs entry +/- MaxLossPoints"
M_REPL = "SL = entry +/- MaxLossPoints (ignore swing)"
M_RULE = "Cap loss at MaxLossPoints only during follow-through window"
maxLossMode  = input.string(M_OFF, "MaxLossMode", options = [M_OFF, M_CAP, M_REPL, M_RULE], group = G3)
maxLossPts   = input.int(2000, "MaxLossPoints", minval = 0, group = G3)
fixWindowBug = input.bool(false, "Close max-loss window even when FollowMode = Off", group = G3, tooltip = "Unchecked reproduces the EA: with FollowMode=Off the window never closes, so the cap acts as a hard stop for the whole trade.")

var string G4 = "4 - Profit protection"
P_NONE = "PROTECTION_NONE"
P_SWNG = "PROTECTION_SWING"
P_CHAN = "PROTECTION_CHANDELIER"
P_TRAL = "PROTECTION_TRAILING"
protMode = input.string(P_TRAL, "ProtectionMode", options = [P_NONE, P_SWNG, P_CHAN, P_TRAL], group = G4)
S_IMM = "START_IMMEDIATELY"
S_PTS = "START_AFTER_POINTS"
protStartMode = input.string(S_IMM, "ProtectionStartMode", options = [S_IMM, S_PTS], group = G4)
protStartPts  = input.int(2000, "ProtectionStartPoints", minval = 0, group = G4)
swingBufPts   = input.int(200,  "SwingBufferPoints",     minval = 0, group = G4)
chLb          = input.int(22,   "ChandelierLookback",    minval = 1, group = G4)
atrLen        = input.int(22,   "ATRPeriod",             minval = 1, group = G4)
atrMult       = input.float(3.0,"ATRMultiplier",         minval = 0, step = 0.1, group = G4)
trailStartPts = input.int(500,  "TrailingStartPoints",   minval = 0, group = G4)
trailDistPts  = input.int(200,  "TrailingDistancePoints",minval = 1, group = G4)
trailStepPts  = input.int(100,  "TrailingStepPoints",    minval = 0, group = G4)

var string G6 = "6 - Display"
showMAs    = input.bool(true, "Show moving averages", group = G6)
showLevels = input.bool(true, "Show entry / stop levels", group = G6)
showLabels = input.bool(true, "Show entry / exit labels", group = G6)
showPanel  = input.bool(true, "Show status panel", group = G6)

pt = ptIn > 0 ? ptIn : syminfo.mintick

// ============================== INDICATORS ===================================
ma18   = ta.sma(close,  fastLen)
ma200  = ta.sma(close,  trendLen)
avgVol = ta.sma(volume, volLen)
atrV   = ta.atr(atrLen)
// Hoisted out of the Chandelier branch below: ta.* series must be evaluated on
// EVERY bar or their internal state desyncs (TradingView warns about this when
// they sit inside a ternary or a conditional block).
chHigh = ta.highest(high, chLb)
chLow  = ta.lowest(low,  chLb)

plot(showMAs ? ma18  : na, "MA Fast",  color = color.new(#26C6DA, 0), linewidth = 2)
plot(showMAs ? ma200 : na, "MA Trend", color = color.new(#FFA726, 0), linewidth = 2)

// ============================ SWING DETECTION ================================
isSwingLow(int sw) =>
    float c  = low[sw]
    bool  ok = not na(c)
    if ok
        for i = 1 to sw
            if na(low[sw + i]) or low[sw + i] <= c or low[sw - i] <= c
                ok := false
                break
    ok

isSwingHigh(int sw) =>
    float c  = high[sw]
    bool  ok = not na(c)
    if ok
        for i = 1 to sw
            if na(high[sw + i]) or high[sw + i] >= c or high[sw - i] >= c
                ok := false
                break
    ok

var float swLowVal  = na
var int   swLowBar  = na
var float swHighVal = na
var int   swHighBar = na
if isSwingLow(swingStr)
    swLowVal := low[swingStr]
    swLowBar := bar_index - swingStr
if isSwingHigh(swingStr)
    swHighVal := high[swingStr]
    swHighBar := bar_index - swingStr
swingLow  = (not na(swLowBar)  and bar_index - swLowBar  <= 99) ? swLowVal  : low
swingHigh = (not na(swHighBar) and bar_index - swHighBar <= 99) ? swHighVal : high

// ============================== ENTRY SIGNALS ================================
volOK   = not useVol or volume > avgVol
buySig  = close > ma200 and close > ma18 and close[1] > ma18[1] and volOK
sellSig = close < ma200 and close < ma18 and close[1] < ma18[1] and volOK

// =============================== STATE MACHINE ===============================
int FLAT   = 0
int PEND_L = 1
int PEND_S = 2
int LONG   = 3
int SHORT  = 4

var int   st         = FLAT
var float entryLvl   = na   // stop-order price while pending / fill price when live
var float slLvl      = na   // the stop that is live on the order right now
var int   entryBar   = na
var bool  windowOpen = false
var float runProfit  = 0.0
var int   nTrades    = 0
var int   nWins      = 0
var float cumPts     = 0.0

ready = bar_index > math.max(trendLen, 100) + swingStr + 2
conf  = barstate.isconfirmed
inWindow = lookbackDays == 0 or time >= timenow - lookbackDays * 86400000

// event flags for this bar
bool evArm    = false
bool evCancel = false
bool evFill   = false
bool evExit   = false
string exitWhy = ""
float exitPx   = na

if conf and ready
    isL = st == LONG
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. FILL
    if st == PEND_L and high >= entryLvl
        st := LONG                  // slLvl already carries the SL sent with the order
        entryBar := bar_index
        windowOpen := true
        runProfit := 0.0
        evFill := true
        isL := true
    else if st == PEND_S and low <= entryLvl
        st := SHORT
        entryBar := bar_index
        windowOpen := true
        runProfit := 0.0
        evFill := true
        isL := false
    else if st == PEND_L and close < ma18       // PendingBuyInvalidated()
        st := FLAT
        evCancel := true
        entryLvl := na
        slLvl := na
    else if st == PEND_S and close > ma18       // PendingSellInvalidated()
        st := FLAT
        evCancel := true
        entryLvl := na
        slLvl := na

    // --------------------------------------------------- 2. LIVE POSITION MGMT
    if st == LONG or st == SHORT
        isL := st == LONG
        // favourable excursion so far (stop entries fill before the bar extreme)
        runProfit := math.max(runProfit, isL ? (high - entryLvl) / pt : (entryLvl - low) / pt)

        // effective stop for THIS bar = order SL, tightened by the max-loss cap
        float effSL = slLvl
        if maxLossMode == M_RULE and windowOpen and maxLossPts > 0
            cap = isL ? entryLvl - maxLossPts * pt : entryLvl + maxLossPts * pt
            effSL := isL ? math.max(nz(effSL, cap), cap) : math.min(nz(effSL, cap), cap)

        // ---- 2a. stop hit intrabar -> flat, at the stop price ----
        if not na(effSL) and (isL ? low <= effSL : high >= effSL)
            exitPx := effSL
            exitWhy := "StopLoss/Protection"
            evExit := true
        else
            age = bar_index - entryBar
            // ---- 2b. follow-through (EA runs this before position mgmt) ----
            if followMode != F_OFF and age >= 1
                if followMode == F_STALL
                    made = isL ? high > high[1] : low < low[1]
                    if not made
                        exitPx := close
                        exitWhy := "No follow-through"
                        evExit := true
                    windowOpen := false
                else if age == 1 and windowOpen
                    ref = followMode == F_TRIG ? entryLvl : (isL ? high[1] : low[1])
                    followed = isL ? high > ref : low < ref
                    if not followed
                        exitPx := close
                        exitWhy := "No follow-through"
                        evExit := true
                    windowOpen := false
            else if followMode == F_OFF and fixWindowBug and age >= 1
                windowOpen := false

            // ---- 2c. MA18 close-back exit ----
            if not evExit and (isL ? close <= ma18 : close >= ma18)
                exitPx := close
                exitWhy := "MA18 exit"
                evExit := true

            // ---- 2d. break-even + protection ratchet (ModifyStopLoss) ----
            if not evExit
                if enableBE and runProfit >= bePts
                    beLvl = isL ? entryLvl + beOff * pt : entryLvl - beOff * pt
                    slLvl := isL ? math.max(nz(slLvl, beLvl), beLvl) : math.min(nz(slLvl, beLvl), beLvl)
                protActive = protStartMode == S_IMM or runProfit >= protStartPts
                if protActive
                    if protMode == P_SWNG
                        ns = isL ? swingLow - swingBufPts * pt : swingHigh + swingBufPts * pt
                        slLvl := isL ? math.max(nz(slLvl, ns), ns) : math.min(nz(slLvl, ns), ns)
                    else if protMode == P_CHAN and atrV > 0
                        ns = isL ? chHigh - atrV * atrMult : chLow + atrV * atrMult
                        slLvl := isL ? math.max(nz(slLvl, ns), ns) : math.min(nz(slLvl, ns), ns)
                    else if protMode == P_TRAL and runProfit >= trailStartPts
                        ns = isL ? close - trailDistPts * pt : close + trailDistPts * pt
                        improved = na(slLvl) or (isL ? ns - slLvl >= trailStepPts * pt : slLvl - ns >= trailStepPts * pt)
                        if improved
                            slLvl := isL ? math.max(nz(slLvl, ns), ns) : math.min(nz(slLvl, ns), ns)

        if evExit
            pts = (isL ? exitPx - entryLvl : entryLvl - exitPx) / pt
            nTrades += 1
            nWins += pts > 0 ? 1 : 0
            cumPts += pts
            st := FLAT
            entryLvl := na
            slLvl := na
            entryBar := na
            windowOpen := false
            runProfit := 0.0

    // ------------------------------------------------------- 3. ARM NEW ORDER
    if st == FLAT and not evFill and inWindow
        if buySig
            e = high + bufPts * pt
            entryLvl := e
            slLvl := maxLossMode == M_REPL ? e - maxLossPts * pt : maxLossMode == M_CAP ? math.max(swingLow, e - maxLossPts * pt) : swingLow
            st := PEND_L
            evArm := true
        else if sellSig
            e = low - bufPts * pt
            entryLvl := e
            slLvl := maxLossMode == M_REPL ? e + maxLossPts * pt : maxLossMode == M_CAP ? math.min(swingHigh, e + maxLossPts * pt) : swingHigh
            st := PEND_S
            evArm := true

// ================================ PLOTS ======================================
pending = st == PEND_L or st == PEND_S
live    = st == LONG   or st == SHORT
plot(showLevels and pending ? entryLvl : na, "Stop-entry level", color = color.new(#B39DDB, 0), style = plot.style_linebr, linewidth = 1)
plot(showLevels and pending ? slLvl    : na, "Pending SL",       color = color.new(#EF9A9A, 40), style = plot.style_linebr, linewidth = 1)
plot(showLevels and live    ? entryLvl : na, "Entry price",      color = color.new(#90CAF9, 0), style = plot.style_linebr, linewidth = 1)
plot(showLevels and live    ? slLvl    : na, "Active SL",        color = color.new(#EF5350, 0), style = plot.style_linebr, linewidth = 2)

plotshape(evArm and st == PEND_L, "Long armed",  shape.triangleup,   location.belowbar, color.new(#26A69A, 0), size = size.tiny)
plotshape(evArm and st == PEND_S, "Short armed", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.new(#EF5350, 0), size = size.tiny)
plotshape(evFill, "Filled", shape.circle, location.belowbar, color.new(#FFEB3B, 0), size = size.tiny)
plotshape(evExit, "Exit",   shape.xcross, location.abovebar, color.new(#B0BEC5, 0), size = size.tiny)

if showLabels and evFill
    label.new(bar_index, entryLvl, (st == LONG ? "LONG " : "SHORT ") + str.tostring(entryLvl, format.mintick) + "\nSL " + str.tostring(slLvl, format.mintick), style = st == LONG ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, color = color.new(st == LONG ? #26A69A : #EF5350, 20), textcolor = color.white, size = size.small)
if showLabels and evExit
    label.new(bar_index, exitPx, "EXIT " + str.tostring(exitPx, format.mintick) + "\n" + exitWhy, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(#546E7A, 20), textcolor = color.white, size = size.small)

// ============================== STATUS PANEL =================================
var table p = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 8, border_width = 1)
if showPanel and barstate.islast
    stName = st == FLAT ? "FLAT" : st == PEND_L ? "BUY STOP ARMED" : st == PEND_S ? "SELL STOP ARMED" : st == LONG ? "LONG" : "SHORT"
    stCol  = st == FLAT ? #546E7A : st == PEND_L or st == LONG ? #2E7D32 : #C62828
    risk   = live and not na(slLvl) ? math.abs(entryLvl - slLvl) / pt : na
    openP  = live ? (st == LONG ? close - entryLvl : entryLvl - close) / pt : na
    wr     = nTrades > 0 ? 100.0 * nWins / nTrades : 0.0
    table.cell(p, 0, 0, "SMA18 v11", bgcolor = #263238, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(p, 1, 0, stName,      bgcolor = stCol,   text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)
    lbl = array.from("chart TF", "entry level", "stop loss", "risk (pts)", "open (pts)", "closed trades", "win % / net pts")
    val = array.from(timeframe.period + (timeframe.period == eaTF ? "" : "  MISMATCH"), na(entryLvl) ? "-" : str.tostring(entryLvl, format.mintick), na(slLvl) ? "-" : str.tostring(slLvl, format.mintick), na(risk) ? "-" : str.tostring(risk, "#"), na(openP) ? "-" : str.tostring(openP, "#"), str.tostring(nTrades), str.tostring(wr, "#.#") + "%  /  " + str.tostring(cumPts, "#"))
    for i = 0 to 6
        table.cell(p, 0, i + 1, array.get(lbl, i), bgcolor = #37474F, text_color = #B0BEC5, text_size = size.small)
        table.cell(p, 1, i + 1, array.get(val, i), bgcolor = #455A64, text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)

// ================================ ALERTS =====================================
// Fixed-condition alerts (Create Alert -> Condition: this indicator).
alertcondition(evArm and st == PEND_L, "Buy stop armed",  "SMA18 v11: BUY STOP armed")
alertcondition(evArm and st == PEND_S, "Sell stop armed", "SMA18 v11: SELL STOP armed")
alertcondition(evFill, "Entry filled", "SMA18 v11: entry FILLED")
alertcondition(evExit, "Exit",         "SMA18 v11: position EXIT")

// Dynamic alert (Create Alert -> Condition: "Any alert() function call").
// Carries live prices, so it works as a webhook payload.
if evArm

//@version=6
// =============================================================================
//  SRK Swing Scanner - batch 1 of 6   (40 symbols, 15m timeframe)
//
//  One script watches 40 F&O underlyings at once and raises a SINGLE
//  TradingView alert naming whichever of them just gave a signal. Pine caps a
//  script at 40 request.security() calls, which is why the F&O list is split
//  across several scripts.
//
//  Signal (the SRK Trading Swing rule, on CLOSED 15m candles):
//    BULLISH  EMA stack flips to Red > Green > Blue  AND  ADX(14) > 20
//    BEARISH  EMA stack flips to Blue > Green > Red  AND  ADX(14) > 20
//    SL       low of the candle before the flip (bullish) / its high (bearish)
//
//  Setup: add to a 15m chart -> Alert -> Condition = this script ->
//         "Any alert() function call" -> tick Show popup + Play sound -> Create.
//  Generated by generate_scanners.py - edit that, not this file.
// =============================================================================
indicator("SRK Swing Scanner B1 (15m)", overlay = true, max_labels_count = 500)

// ---------------------------- Signal settings -------------------------------
tf      = input.timeframe("15", "Scan timeframe", group = "Signal")
fastLen = input.int(5,    "Red EMA (fast)",  minval = 1, group = "Signal")
midLen  = input.int(10,   "Green EMA (mid)", minval = 1, group = "Signal")
slowLen = input.int(20,   "Blue EMA (slow)", minval = 1, group = "Signal")

adxThr  = input.float(20, "ADX threshold",   group = "Signal")

// ---------------------------- Noise filters ---------------------------------
// Measured on b1 (the 40 busiest F&O names) over a real session:
//   defaults below (loose flip, ADX>20) ....... ~13 alerts/day
//   + ADX 25 or 30 ............................. ~4 alerts/day
//   + "Require a flip from the opposite stack" .. ~2 alerts/day
// The last of those matches how rarely the SRK indicator plots a triangle, but
// it is too quiet to be useful as an ALERT - a whole session can pass with one
// signal, fired at 09:15. Start here and tighten only if the flow is too noisy.
alternateOnly   = input.bool(true, "Only alternate signals (no repeat in same direction)", group = "Noise filters")
requireOpposite = input.bool(false, "Require a flip straight from the opposite stack", group = "Noise filters")
cooldownBars    = input.int(0, "Minimum bars between signals", minval = 0, group = "Noise filters")

// ---------------------------- Display settings ------------------------------
showPanel = input.bool(true, "Show scanner panel", group = "Display")
panelPos  = input.string("Top right", "Panel position", group = "Display",
     options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left", "Middle right"])
onlyHits  = input.bool(false, "Panel: only symbols signalling right now", group = "Display")
markChart = input.bool(true,  "Draw signals on this chart's own symbol", group = "Display")

// ---------------------------- The SRK swing rule ----------------------------
// Runs once per symbol, inside that symbol's own context via request.security.
srk() =>
    r = ta.ema(close, fastLen)
    g = ta.ema(close, midLen)
    b = ta.ema(close, slowLen)
    [_diP, _diM, adxv] = ta.dmi(adxLen, adxLen)
    up = r > g and g > b                       // RGB: red on top
    dn = b > g and g > r                       // BGR: blue on top
    state = up ? 1 : dn ? -1 : 0
    flip  = state != 0 and state != state[1]   // first bar the stack aligns
    raw   = flip and adxv > adxThr and (not requireOpposite or state[1] == -state)

    // Kept per symbol, because "have we already signalled this swing?" is a
    // per-symbol question and request.security runs this in each one's context.
    var int lastDir = 0
    var int lastBar = -1000000
    fire = raw and (not alternateOnly or state != lastDir) and (bar_index - lastBar >= cooldownBars)
    if fire

        lastBar := bar_index

    sig = fire ? state : 0
    sl  = not fire ? na : state == 1 ? low[1] : high[1]
    [sig, state, close, adxv, sl]
