//@version=6
// =============================================================================
//  Realtime Momentum Tracker  +  Momentum Flow   (saved as "trade_with_kareena")
//  Original implementation (inspired by the visible behaviour of a multi-TF
//  buying/selling volume momentum table). High-speed, recalculates live.
//
//  What it shows:
//   1. A multi-timeframe table: for each TF it splits volume into BUYING vs
//      SELLING pressure and prints a Positive (BUY) / Negative (SELL) result.
//   2. A "Momentum Flow" line + histogram (own pane) that reacts in realtime.
// =============================================================================
indicator("trade_with_kareena", shorttitle="trade_with_kareena", overlay=false, max_labels_count=500)

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Inputs
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
grpT   = "Multi-Timeframe Table"
showTbl   = input.bool(true,  "Show momentum table",          group=grpT)
tblPos    = input.string("top_right", "Table position", options=["top_right","top_left","bottom_right","bottom_left","middle_right"], group=grpT)
useVolStr = input.bool(true,  "Use volume strength (vs avg)", group=grpT, tooltip="Weights each TF result by how far volume is above its average.")

grpF   = "Momentum Flow"
showFlow  = input.bool(true,  "Show momentum flow on chart",  group=grpF)
flowLen   = input.int(20, "Flow smoothing length", minval=1,  group=grpF)
flowMult  = input.float(1.0,"Flow visual scale",   minval=0.1,group=grpF)

grpC   = "Colors"
colBuy    = input.color(color.new(#26a69a, 0), "Buy / Positive",  group=grpC)
colSell   = input.color(color.new(#ef5350, 0), "Sell / Negative", group=grpC)
colNeu    = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 0), "Neutral",      group=grpC)

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Core: split a bar's volume into buying vs selling pressure (close-in-range).
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
buyingVolume() =>
    rng = math.max(high - low, syminfo.mintick)
    buyFrac = (close - low) / rng
    volume * buyFrac

sellingVolume() =>
    rng = math.max(high - low, syminfo.mintick)
    sellFrac = (high - close) / rng
    volume * sellFrac

f_tf(tf) =>
    bv = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, buyingVolume(),  barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
    sv = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, sellingVolume(), barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
    v  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, volume,          barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
    va = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, ta.sma(volume, 20), barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
    base  = (bv - sv) / math.max(bv + sv, 1)
    strength = useVolStr ? math.max(v / math.max(va, 1), 0.0) : 1.0
    score = base * strength
    [bv, sv, score]

[bv1,  sv1,  sc1]  = f_tf("1")
[bv3,  sv3,  sc3]  = f_tf("3")
[bv5,  sv5,  sc5]  = f_tf("5")
[bv15, sv15, sc15] = f_tf("15")
[bv30, sv30, sc30] = f_tf("30")
[bv60, sv60, sc60] = f_tf("60")
[bv240,sv240,sc240]= f_tf("240")
[bvD,  svD,  scD]  = f_tf("1D")

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Formatting helpers (all global)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
f_fmt(x) =>
    a = math.abs(x)
    a >= 1e9 ? str.tostring(x / 1e9, "#.##") + "B" : a >= 1e6 ? str.tostring(x / 1e6, "#.##") + "M" : a >= 1e3 ? str.tostring(x / 1e3, "#.##") + "K" : str.tostring(x, "#.##")

f_resTxt(sc) => sc > 0 ? "Positive (BUY)" : sc < 0 ? "Negative (SELL)" : "Neutral"

// Table row writer — MUST be global (Pine forbids defining functions inside if)
f_row(tbl, row, label, bv, sv, sc) =>
    table.cell(tbl, 0, row, label,        text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 70), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(tbl, 1, row, f_fmt(bv),    text_color=colBuy,      bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(tbl, 2, row, f_fmt(sv),    text_color=colSell,     bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(tbl, 3, row, f_resTxt(sc), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=f_resCol(sc),               text_size=size.small)

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Momentum Table
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
var table mt = na
if showTbl
    pos = tblPos == "top_left" ? position.top_left : tblPos == "bottom_right" ? position.bottom_right : tblPos == "bottom_left" ? position.bottom_left : tblPos == "middle_right" ? position.middle_right : position.top_right
    if na(mt)
        mt := table.new(pos, 4, 9, border_width=1)
    table.cell(mt, 0, 0, "Periods",        text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 30), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(mt, 1, 0, "Buying Volume",  text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 30), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(mt, 2, 0, "Selling Volume", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 30), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(mt, 3, 0, "Result",         text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 30), text_size=size.small)
    f_row(mt, 1, "1m",  bv1,  sv1,  sc1)
    f_row(mt, 2, "3m",  bv3,  sv3,  sc3)
    f_row(mt, 3, "5m",  bv5,  sv5,  sc5)
    f_row(mt, 4, "15m", bv15, sv15, sc15)
    f_row(mt, 5, "30m", bv30, sv30, sc30)
    f_row(mt, 6, "1h",  bv60, sv60, sc60)
    f_row(mt, 7, "4h",  bv240,sv240,sc240)
    f_row(mt, 8, "1D",  bvD,  svD,  scD)

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Momentum Flow (own pane, realtime)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
aggScore = (sc1 + sc3 + sc5 + sc15 + sc30 + sc60 + sc240 + scD) / 8.0
flow = ta.ema(aggScore, flowLen) * flowMult
flowCol = flow > 0 ? colBuy : flow < 0 ? colSell : colNeu
histCol = flow >= 0 ? (flow >= nz(flow[1]) ? colBuy : color.new(colBuy, 55)) : (flow <= nz(flow[1]) ? colSell : color.new(colSell, 55))

plot(showFlow ? flow : na, "Momentum Flow Hist", color=histCol, style=plot.style_columns)
plot(showFlow ? flow : na, "Momentum Flow Line", color=flowCol, linewidth=2)
hline(0, "Zero", color=color.new(color.gray, 60), linestyle=hline.style_dotted)

flipUp   = ta.crossover(flow, 0)
flipDown = ta.crossunder(flow, 0)
plotshape(showFlow and flipUp,   title="Flow Up",   style=shape.triangleup,   location=location.bottom, color=colBuy,  size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showFlow and flipDown, title="Flow Down", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.top,    color=colSell, size=size.tiny)

indicator("trade_with_kareena Flow", shorttitle="TWK Flow", overlay=false)

grpF = "Momentum Flow"
flowLen   = input.int(20, "Flow smoothing length", minval=1, group=grpF)
flowMult  = input.float(1.0, "Flow visual scale", minval=0.1, group=grpF)
useVolStr = input.bool(true, "Weight by volume strength", group=grpF)

grpA = "ADX"

buyingVolume() =>
    rng = math.max(high - low, syminfo.mintick)
    volume * ((close - low) / rng)
sellingVolume() =>
    rng = math.max(high - low, syminfo.mintick)

f_tf(tf) =>
    bv = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, buyingVolume(),  barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

    va = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, ta.sma(volume, 20), barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
    base = (bv - sv) / math.max(bv + sv, 1)
    strength = useVolStr ? math.max(v / math.max(va, 1), 0.0) : 1.0
    base * strength

sc1   = f_tf("1")
sc3   = f_tf("3")
sc5   = f_tf("5")
sc15  = f_tf("15")
sc30  = f_tf("30")
sc60  = f_tf("60")
sc240 = f_tf("240")
scD   = f_tf("1D")

aggScore = (sc1 + sc3 + sc5 + sc15 + sc30 + sc60 + sc240 + scD) / 8.0
flow = ta.ema(aggScore, flowLen) * flowMult
flowCol = flow > 0 ? colBuy : flow < 0 ? colSell : color.gray
histCol = flow >= 0 ? (flow >= nz(flow[1]) ? colBuy : color.new(colBuy, 55)) : (flow <= nz(flow[1]) ? colSell : color.new(colSell, 55))

plot(flow, "Momentum Flow Hist", color=histCol, style=plot.style_columns)
plot(flow, "Momentum Flow Line", color=flowCol, linewidth=2)
hline(0, "Zero", color=color.new(color.gray, 60), linestyle=hline.style_dotted)

flipUp   = ta.crossover(flow, 0)
flipDown = ta.crossunder(flow, 0)
plotshape(flipUp,   "Flow Up",   shape.triangleup,   location.bottom, colBuy,  size=size.tiny)
plotshape(flipDown, "Flow Down", shape.triangledown, location.top,    colSell, size=size.tiny)

[diP, diM, adxVal] = ta.dmi(adxLen, adxSmooth)
adxCol = adxVal >= adxThresh ? color.new(color.orange, 0) : color.new(color.gray, 30)
plot(showAdxLine ? adxVal : na, "ADX", color=adxCol, linewidth=1)

var table at = na
if na(at)
    at := table.new(position.bottom_right, 1, 1, border_width=1)
table.cell(at, 0, 0, "ADX: " + str.tostring(adxVal, "#0.0") + (adxVal >= adxThresh ? "  STRONG" : "  weak"), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=adxCol, text_size=size.small)

alertcondition(flipUp,   "Momentum Flow BULLISH", "Flow crossed above zero")
alertcondition(flipDown, "Momentum Flow BEARISH", "Flow crossed below zero")

//@version=6
strategy("trade_with_kareena Strategy", shorttitle="TWK Strat", overlay=true, initial_capital=10000, default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=10, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.02, slippage=2, pyramiding=0, max_labels_count=500, max_boxes_count=100, max_lines_count=100)

stATR  = input.int(10, "Smart Trail ATR length", minval=1, group=grpS)
pivLen = input.int(5, "Pivot strength for stop", minval=1, group=grpS)
rr     = input.float(2.0, "Reward : Risk (target)", minval=0.5, group=grpS)

grpF = "Filter (optional)"
useRF = input.bool(false, "Require R-Factor confirmation", group=grpF)
rLen  = input.int(14, "R-Factor lookback", minval=2, group=grpF)

[stVal, stDir] = ta.supertrend(stMult, stATR)
bullFlip = stDir < 0 and stDir[1] >= 0
bearFlip = stDir > 0 and stDir[1] <= 0

ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivLen, pivLen)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivLen, pivLen)
var float lastPL = na
var float lastPH = na
if not na(pl)
    lastPL := pl
if not na(ph)
    lastPH := ph

priceMom   = (ta.rsi(close, rLen) - 50) / 50 * 20
volScore   = math.max(math.min(volume / math.max(ta.sma(volume, rLen), 1) - 1, 1), -1) * 20
smartScore = (ta.mfi(hlc3, rLen) - 50) / 50 * 20
rFactor    = priceMom + volScore + smartScore

longCond  = bullFlip and (not useRF or rFactor > 0)
shortCond = bearFlip and (not useRF or rFactor < 0)

if longCond and strategy.position_size == 0
    e = close
    s = (not na(lastPL) and lastPL < e) ? lastPL : stVal
    r = e - s
    if r > 0
        t = e + rr * r
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
        strategy.exit("L-exit", "Long", stop=s, limit=t)

if shortCond and strategy.position_size == 0
    e = close
    s = (not na(lastPH) and lastPH > e) ? lastPH : stVal
    r = s - e
    if r > 0
        t = e - rr * r
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
        strategy.exit("S-exit", "Short", stop=s, limit=t)

plot(stVal, "Smart Trail", color=#7e57c2, style=plot.style_linebr)

//@version=6
indicator("trade_with_kareena Tracker", shorttitle="TWK Tracker", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_boxes_count=100, max_lines_count=100)

grpT = "Table"
showTbl   = input.bool(true, "Show combined table", group=grpT)
tblPos    = input.string("top_right", "Table position", options=["top_right","top_left","bottom_right","bottom_left","middle_right"], group=grpT)
volLen    = input.int(20, "Volume MA Length (bars)", minval=1, group=grpT)
rowAlpha  = input.int(15, "Row color opacity", minval=0, maxval=80, group=grpT)
tblSize   = input.string("small", "Table font size", options=["small","normal","large","huge"], group=grpT)

grpR = "R-Factor"
rLen     = input.int(14, "R-Factor lookback", minval=2, group=grpR)
benchSym = input.symbol("NSE:NIFTY", "Benchmark for Sector Strength", group=grpR, tooltip="Index/sector for relative strength. For crypto try CRYPTOCAP:TOTAL or BINANCE:BTCUSDT. Invalid symbols score 0.")

grpL = "Smart Trail (purple line)"
showLine = input.bool(true, "Show Smart Trail", group=grpL)
stMult   = input.float(1.5, "Multiplier", minval=0.5, group=grpL)
stATR    = input.int(10, "ATR length", minval=1, group=grpL)
colLine  = input.color(#7e57c2, "Line color", group=grpL)

grpS = "LONG / SHORT Signals"
showSig    = input.bool(true, "Show LONG/SHORT signals", group=grpS)
sigConfirm = input.bool(false, "Require R-Factor confirmation", group=grpS)

grpB = "Institutional Footprint Bubbles"
showBub   = input.bool(true, "Show footprint bubbles", group=grpB)
bubLen    = input.int(20, "Volume average length", minval=1, group=grpB)
bubMult   = input.float(1.8, "Volume threshold (x avg)", minval=1.0, group=grpB)

grpD = "Reversal Pivot Dots"
showDots = input.bool(true, "Show purple pivot dots", group=grpD)
pivLen   = input.int(5, "Pivot strength (bars each side)", minval=1, group=grpD)
colDot   = input.color(#9c27b0, "Dot color", group=grpD)

grpP = "1:2 Auto Position (R:R)"
showPos  = input.bool(true, "Plot current LONG/SHORT position", group=grpP)
rr       = input.float(2.0, "Reward : Risk", minval=0.5, group=grpP, tooltip="Target distance = this x stop distance. 2 = 1:2.")
projBars = input.int(24, "Projection width (bars)", minval=3, group=grpP)

grpC = "Colors"
colBuy  = input.color(color.new(#26a69a, 0), "Buy / Positive", group=grpC)
colSell = input.color(color.new(#ef5350, 0), "Sell / Negative", group=grpC)

f_tf(tf) =>
    [bV, sV] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, [math.sum(close > open ? volume : 0.0, volLen), math.sum(close < open ? volume : 0.0, volLen)], barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
    score = (bV - sV) / math.max(bV + sV, 1)
    [bV, sV, score]

[bv1,  sv1,  sc1]  = f_tf("1")
[bv3,  sv3,  sc3]  = f_tf("3")
[bv5,  sv5,  sc5]  = f_tf("5")
[bv15, sv15, sc15] = f_tf("15")
[bv30, sv30, sc30] = f_tf("30")
[bv60, sv60, sc60] = f_tf("60")
[bv120,sv120,sc120]= f_tf("120")
[bv240,sv240,sc240]= f_tf("240")
[bvD,  svD,  scD]  = f_tf("1D")

f_fmt(x) =>
    a = math.abs(x)
    a >= 1e9 ? str.tostring(x/1e9, "#.##")+"B" : a >= 1e6 ? str.tostring(x/1e6, "#.##")+"M" : a >= 1e3 ? str.tostring(x/1e3, "#.##")+"K" : str.tostring(x, "#.##")
f_resTxt(s) => s > 0 ? "Positive (BUY)" : s < 0 ? "Negative (SELL)" : "Neutral"
f_rowCol(s) => s > 0 ? color.new(colBuy, rowAlpha) : s < 0 ? color.new(colSell, rowAlpha) : color.new(color.gray, 40)
f_pos(p) => p=="top_left"?position.top_left : p=="top_right"?position.top_right : p=="bottom_left"?position.bottom_left : p=="bottom_right"?position.bottom_right : position.middle_right
f_sc(v) => (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(v, "#0.0")
f_tsize(s) => s=="small"?size.small : s=="normal"?size.normal : s=="huge"?size.huge : size.large
ts = f_tsize(tblSize)

f_row(tbl, row, label, bv, sv, sc) =>
    rc = f_rowCol(sc)
    table.cell(tbl, 0, row, label,        text_color=color.white, bgcolor=rc, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(tbl, 1, row, f_fmt(bv),    text_color=color.white, bgcolor=rc, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(tbl, 2, row, f_fmt(sv),    text_color=color.white, bgcolor=rc, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(tbl, 3, row, f_resTxt(sc), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=rc, text_size=ts)

f_comp(tbl, row, name, score) =>
    cc = f_rowCol(score)
    table.cell(tbl, 0, row, name,        text_color=color.white, bgcolor=cc, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(tbl, 1, row, f_sc(score), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=cc, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(tbl, 2, row, "",          text_color=color.white, bgcolor=cc, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(tbl, 3, row, "",          text_color=color.white, bgcolor=cc, text_size=ts)

priceMom   = (ta.rsi(close, rLen) - 50) / 50 * 20
volRatio   = volume / math.max(ta.sma(volume, rLen), 1)
volScore   = math.max(math.min(volRatio - 1, 1), -1) * 20
bench      = request.security(benchSym, timeframe.period, close, barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off, ignore_invalid_symbol=true)
rs         = na(bench) or na(bench[rLen]) ? na : (close / close[rLen]) / (bench / bench[rLen])
sectorScore= na(rs) ? 0.0 : math.max(math.min((rs - 1) * 50, 1), -1) * 20
oiScore    = math.max(math.min(ta.roc(ta.sma(volume, rLen), rLen) / 100, 1), -1) * 20
smartScore = (ta.mfi(hlc3, rLen) - 50) / 50 * 20

rFactor = priceMom + volScore + sectorScore + oiScore + smartScore
rCol    = f_rowCol(rFactor)
rBias   = rFactor > 33 ? "STRONG BUY" : rFactor > 0 ? "BUY" : rFactor < -33 ? "STRONG SELL" : rFactor < 0 ? "SELL" : "NEUTRAL"

hCol = color.new(#2a2e39, 0)
var table mt = na
if showTbl
    if na(mt)
        mt := table.new(f_pos(tblPos), 4, 16, border_width=1)
    table.cell(mt, 0,0,"Periods",        text_color=color.white, bgcolor=hCol, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(mt, 1,0,"Buying Volume",  text_color=color.white, bgcolor=hCol, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(mt, 2,0,"Selling Volume", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=hCol, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(mt, 3,0,"Result",         text_color=color.white, bgcolor=hCol, text_size=ts)
    f_row(mt,1,"1m",  bv1,  sv1,  sc1)
    f_row(mt,2,"3m",  bv3,  sv3,  sc3)
    f_row(mt,3,"5m",  bv5,  sv5,  sc5)
    f_row(mt,4,"15m", bv15, sv15, sc15)
    f_row(mt,5,"30m", bv30, sv30, sc30)
    f_row(mt,6,"1h",  bv60, sv60, sc60)
    f_row(mt,7,"2h",  bv120,sv120,sc120)
    f_row(mt,8,"4h",  bv240,sv240,sc240)
    f_row(mt,9,"1D",  bvD,  svD,  scD)
    table.cell(mt, 0,10,"R-FACTOR",         text_color=color.white, bgcolor=rCol, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(mt, 1,10,str.tostring(rFactor,"#0.0"), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=rCol, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(mt, 2,10,"BIAS",             text_color=color.white, bgcolor=rCol, text_size=ts)
    table.cell(mt, 3,10,rBias,              text_color=color.white, bgcolor=rCol, text_size=ts)
    f_comp(mt,11,"Price Momentum",   priceMom)
    f_comp(mt,12,"Volume",           volScore)
    f_comp(mt,13,"Sector Strength",  sectorScore)
    f_comp(mt,14,"OI / Derivatives", oiScore)
    f_comp(mt,15,"Smart Money Flow", smartScore)

[stVal, stDir] = ta.supertrend(stMult, stATR)
plot(showLine ? stVal : na, "Smart Trail", color=colLine, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)

bullFlip = stDir < 0 and stDir[1] >= 0
bearFlip = stDir > 0 and stDir[1] <= 0
longSig  = bullFlip and (not sigConfirm or rFactor > 0)
shortSig = bearFlip and (not sigConfirm or rFactor < 0)

if showSig and longSig
    label.new(bar_index, low, "LONG", yloc=yloc.belowbar, style=label.style_label_up, color=colBuy, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
if showSig and shortSig
    label.new(bar_index, high, "SHORT", yloc=yloc.abovebar, style=label.style_label_down, color=colSell, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)

vAvg  = ta.sma(volume, bubLen)
isBig = volume >= bubMult * vAvg
ratio = volume / math.max(vAvg, 1)
bSize = ratio > 4 ? size.huge : ratio > 3 ? size.large : ratio > 2 ? size.normal : size.small
bubCol = close >= open ? color.new(colBuy, 10) : color.new(colSell, 10)
if showBub and isBig
    label.new(bar_index, hlc3, f_fmt(volume), style=label.style_circle, color=bubCol, textcolor=color.white, size=bSize)

ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivLen, pivLen)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivLen, pivLen)
plotshape(showDots and not na(ph), title="Pivot High Dot", style=shape.circle, location=location.abovebar, color=colDot, offset=-pivLen, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showDots and not na(pl), title="Pivot Low Dot",  style=shape.circle, location=location.belowbar, color=colDot, offset=-pivLen, size=size.tiny)

var float lastPL = na
var float lastPH = na
if not na(pl)
    lastPL := pl
if not na(ph)
    lastPH := ph

// Keep only ONE position — the current/latest one (delete the previous on each new signal).
var box   pbRwd = na
var box   pbRsk = na
var line  plEnt = na
var label plLE  = na
var label plLT  = na
var label plLS  = na

if showPos and (longSig or shortSig)
    isL = longSig
    entry = close
    sl = isL ? ((not na(lastPL) and lastPL < close) ? lastPL : stVal) : ((not na(lastPH) and lastPH > close) ? lastPH : stVal)
    risk = isL ? (entry - sl) : (sl - entry)
    if risk > 0
        tp = isL ? (entry + rr * risk) : (entry - rr * risk)
        l = bar_index
        rgt = l + projBars
        if not na(pbRwd)
            box.delete(pbRwd)
        if not na(pbRsk)
            box.delete(pbRsk)
        if not na(plEnt)
            line.delete(plEnt)
        if not na(plLE)
            label.delete(plLE)
        if not na(plLT)
            label.delete(plLT)
        if not na(plLS)
            label.delete(plLS)
        pbRwd := box.new(l, math.max(entry, tp), rgt, math.min(entry, tp), border_color=color.new(colBuy, 0),  bgcolor=color.new(colBuy, 60))
        pbRsk := box.new(l, math.max(entry, sl), rgt, math.min(entry, sl), border_color=color.new(colSell, 0), bgcolor=color.new(colSell, 60))
        plEnt := line.new(l, entry, rgt, entry, color=color.new(color.white, 0), width=2, style=line.style_dashed)
        plLE := label.new(l, entry, (isL ? "LONG @ " : "SHORT @ ") + str.tostring(entry, format.mintick) + "  (1:" + str.tostring(rr, "#.#") + ")", style=label.style_label_right, color=color.new(color.gray, 10), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
        plLT := label.new(l, tp, "TP " + str.tostring(tp, format.mintick), style=label.style_label_right, color=color.new(colBuy, 0),  textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
        plLS := label.new(l, sl, "SL " + str.tostring(sl, format.mintick), style=label.style_label_right, color=color.new(colSell, 0), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)

alertcondition(longSig,  "TWK LONG signal",  "trade_with_kareena: LONG (Smart Trail flip up)")
alertcondition(shortSig, "TWK SHORT signal", "trade_with_kareena: SHORT (Smart Trail flip down)")
